# International Transaction Journal of Engineering, Management, & Applied Sciences & Technologies

> > A multidisciplinary academic journal publishing peer-reviewed research across engineering, management, applied sciences, and technology from institutions worldwide.

The journal features research from diverse international institutions including Thammasat University (Thailand), universities in India, Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Russia. It covers topics ranging from plant biotechnology and renewable energy to supply chain management, urban planning, and educational research.

## Key Topics

- Engineering research
- Management sciences
- Applied sciences
- Plant biotechnology and micropropagation
- COVID-19 impact studies
- Tourism and hospitality management
- Supply chain risk management
- Renewable energy and desalination
- Urban planning and design
- Higher education research
- ICT adoption in SMEs
- Electric vehicle technology
- Saudi Arabia
- India and Pakistan
- Southeast Asian research

## Engineering & Technology

- [Effective Hybrid Solar Groundwater Desalination in Rural Areas](https://tuengr.com/A12/12A3/12A3M.html): Hybrid solar desalination system for rural groundwater treatment
- [Integration of Virtual Resistor in Charging Control System of Electric Vehicles to Mitigate the Harmonic Issues at Power Grid Side](https://tuengr.com/A12/12A3/12A3T.html): Virtual resistor integration for EV charging harmonic mitigation
- [Simulation and Energy Saving Optimization in Naphtha Splitter](https://tuengr.com/A12/12A7/12A7D.html): ASPEN HYSYS optimization for naphtha splitter energy efficiency
- [Anomaly Detection in Crowds by Fusion of Novel Feature Descriptors](https://tuengr.com/A11A/11A16/11A16B.html): Crowd anomaly detection using feature fusion & trajectory analysis

## Management & Business Studies

- [A Framework for Identifying and Managing Risk Impact Factors for Disruptions in the Food Supply Chain](https://tuengr.com/A12/12A4/12A4U.html): ISM-MICMAC framework for food supply chain risk management
- [BANKRUPTCY DYNAMICS OF COMPANIES IN RUSSIA](https://tuengr.com/A11A/11A13/11A13H.html): Russian company bankruptcy analysis by Ural State University researchers
- [Drivers of ICT Adoption in Small and Very Small Businesses in Technologically Least Developed District of Southern Punjab](https://tuengr.com/A12/12A1/12A1K.html): ICT adoption drivers for SMEs in Southern Punjab, Pakistan
- [Bridging the Expectancy Gap between the Industry and Academia in Higher Management Education in India by Applying the Vroom's Expectancy Model](https://tuengr.com/A12/12A2/12A2A.html): Vroom's Expectancy Model applied to India management education gap

## Tourism & Hospitality Research

- [Impacts of Covid-19 on Tourism Industry: A Comparative Review of Select Countries](https://tuengr.com/A12/12A5/12A5E.html): COVID-19 impact analysis on tourism industry across multiple countries
- [Deciphering Key Factors Impacting Online Hotel Ratings Through the Lens of Two-Factor Theory: A Case of Hotels in the Makkah City of Saudi Arabia](https://tuengr.com/A12/12A8/12A8M.html): Two-Factor Theory analysis of Makkah hotel online ratings & reviews

## Education & Human Resources

- [The Mentorship Effectiveness of Demographic and Professional Characteristics of University PhD Teachers in Pakistan](https://tuengr.com/A12/12A8/12A8N.html): PhD faculty mentorship effectiveness study at Pakistani universities
- [Factors Affecting Job Satisfaction of White-collar Officers in the Ho Chi Minh City of Vietnam](https://tuengr.com/A12/12A6/12A6D.html): Job satisfaction factors for white-collar workers in Ho Chi Minh City
- [The Position of Risk Propensity and Resilience among Saudi Youth Vis-a-vis Certain Other Nationalities](https://tuengr.com/A12/12A1/12A1U.html): Comparative study of risk propensity & resilience in Saudi youth

## Urban Planning & Environmental Studies

- [Community-Based Spatial Planning in Supporting Equitable Eco-Villages at Tibang Village in Aceh Province of Indonesia](https://tuengr.com/A12/12A2/12A2O.html): Eco-village spatial planning at Tibang Village, Aceh Province, Indonesia
- [Parklet Ideas Making Small Street Urban Spaces with Big Impacts](https://tuengr.com/A11A/11A15/11A15N.html): Parklet design concepts for urban streetscapes in Jazan City, Saudi Arabia

## Mathematical & Computational Methods

- [An Approximate Analytical Solution of Non-Linear Fractional-Order Constrained Optimization Problem Using Optimal Homotopy Analysis Method](https://tuengr.com/A12/12A1/12A1D.html): Optimal Homotopy Analysis Method for fractional-order optimization

## Journal Archives

- [V11(10):2020 International Transaction Journal of Engineering, Management, & Applied Sciences & Technologies](https://tuengr.com/Vol11_10.html): Archive: Vol 11 Issue 10 (2020) IDSISA2020 Conference special issue

- [Vol 3(2): 2012 International Transaction Journal of Engineering, Management, & Applied Sciences & Technologies](https://tuengr.com/Vol32.html): Archive: Vol 3 Issue 2 (April 2012) with plant biotechnology research
